name: In Laws
overview: Scripture establishes the foundation of family relationships beginning with God's command to multiply and fill the earth, highlighting the creation of a suitable helper for man and the unity of husband and wife as one flesh (Genesis 1:28; 2:18, 24). This divine design implies a clear transition where a man leaves his parents to cleave to his wife, shaping the framework in which in-laws relate to one another. While the sample verses do not mention in-laws directly, they underscore the sanctity of marriage and the respect for others' households and relationships, as seen in the prohibition against coveting a neighbor's wife or possessions (Exodus 20:17). Together, these passages emphasize honoring God's order in family and relational boundaries.
